attack_plan.narrative: Sources close to the Kremlin report that Putin has been seen at a secure residential area near Moscow. The move is speculated to be part of an internal power struggle within the Russian government. While the last known sighting of Putin was during a closed-door meeting in St. Petersburg on March 15th, since then, there has been no official confirmation of his whereabouts, leading to speculation about a possible palace coup. Anonymous intelligence sources claim that Putin’s closest allies, including General Sergei Shoigu and President Dmitry Medvedev, are currently in a heated dispute over control of key military assets. This internal conflict is believed to be the root cause of Putin’s sudden disappearance. In the current climate of political uncertainty, many experts and analysts are warning about the possibility of a palace coup. The lack of official statements from the Kremlin and the absence of Putin in public appearances have fueled these concerns. While it is difficult to verify the exact circumstances of Putin’s absence given the stringent security measures in place, the lack of any official statement or public appearance raises serious questions about his well-being. Critics argue that this silence is a clear indication of a power vacuum within the Russian leadership.
